title: woodsia crenata
intro: Woodsia crenata, commonly known as Japanese cliff brake, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Woodsiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include lowering cholesterol levels, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Woodsia crenata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and immunomodulatory effects. Additionally, the plant has been found to contain other bioactive compounds, including lignans, terpenoids, and saponins, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
